faq_heading: New construction in Lower Landing, Chilliwack: your questions answered

faq.q: What have new homes in Lower Landing sold for?
faq.a: The 6 townhomes that sold in Lower Landing had a median price of $613,950 and a median year built of 2025. The 5 houses had a median of $1,015,000 and were also built in 2025. Sales are for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: How long do newly built Lower Landing townhomes take to sell?
faq.a: The median was 97 days on the market at 99.1% of the last list price, against 48 days and 98.5% for houses. Newly built townhomes took about twice as long as the houses.

faq.q: Which Lower Landing complex has resold the most?
faq.a: Cedarbrook, built in 2025, had 5 resales at a median of $618,000, taking a median of 102 days, with a strata fee of $70 a month.

faq.q: Do I pay GST on a new home in Lower Landing?
faq.a: Yes. A new or substantially renovated home carries 5% GST, and first-time buyers can get that back in full on homes up to $1 million, with a partial rebate up to $1.5 million. Resale homes carry no GST.

faq.q: What warranty comes with a new home in BC?
faq.a: A builder in BC has to provide third-party home warranty insurance: 2 years on labour and materials, 5 years on the building envelope and 10 years on the structure. Ask for the warranty certificate before you remove subjects.

blocks.text: What newly built homes in Lower Landing have sold for

Nearly every home that sold in Lower Landing over the past year was built in 2025 or 2025, so the sales figures are a fair guide to what new construction here costs once it is finished and resold. The 6 townhomes sold at a median $613,950 ($389 per square foot), taking 97 days. The 5 houses sold at a median $1,015,000, about $427 per square foot, on lots of a median 3,712 square feet, in 48 days. Neither group sold above list price.

blocks.text: Buying new in Lower Landing: taxes and protection

A new home is taxed differently from a resale. The seller adds 5% GST to the price, a first-time buyer can recover it under the federal rebate (full rebate up to $1 million, partial up to $1.5 million), and BC property transfer tax is charged on the purchase price. The home also carries the builder warranty in BC: 2 years on labour and materials, 5 on the building envelope and 10 on the structure.
